value.text:
The University of Pinar del Río "Hermanos Saiz Montes de Oca" is a public university in Pinar del Río, Cuba, founded in 1972. Its Spanish name is Universidad de Pinar del Río "Hermanos Saíz Montes de Oca", and it uses the abbreviation UPR. The institution is also classified as an open-access publisher.

Its academic structure includes faculties of Economics, Social Sciences and Humanities, Technical Sciences, and Forestry and Agriculture. Education is represented by faculties covering Physical Education, Early Childhood Education, and Secondary Education. Together, these faculties span economic, humanistic, technical, agricultural, forestry, and educational fields.
